@graph.name: Answer-Evidence Questions
@graph.description: Every question of the buyer-intent rubric — 56650 rows generated from the rubric database, never hand-kept — with its intent class, service, geo scope, target page, money weight, Answer Panel membership state, and its fragment-binding state: bound exactly to the fragment that should answer it, covered at page level, or carrying no fragment on its target page yet. The full question rows are published in the companion file datasets-answer-evidence-questions.json (this node in that file, at the same @id, carries the array); this file carries the counts and the reference, so neither file crosses the hosting per-file size limit as the rubric grows. Rows omit a field whose value is the default: panelState defaults to “not a panel question.”, panelMember to false, owningFragmentId to null and moneyWeight to “standard”; non-default values are carried verbatim.
